title.en: New in the workshop: Bambu Lab X2D
title.sl: Novo v delavnici: Bambu Lab X2D

summary.en: A dual-nozzle printer with an actively heated chamber now runs next to the P1S, so strong engineering materials and cleaner supports are part of every quote.
summary.sl: Ob P1S zdaj tiska še tiskalnik z dvema šobama in aktivno ogrevano komoro, zato so trdni inženirski materiali in čistejše podpore del vsake ponudbe.

body.en:
The Bambu Lab X2D is now printing in the workshop, next to the P1S. Here is what it changes for your parts:

- Two nozzles: one prints the part, the second prints a dedicated support material, so overhangs come out cleaner with less waste and less post-processing.
- An actively heated chamber (up to 65 °C) and a 300 °C hotend: ABS, ASA, nylon (PA), carbon-fibre nylon (PA-CF) and PC print reliably, without warping.
- 256 × 256 × 260 mm build volume.
- AMS for multi-colour and multi-material jobs.
- Built-in HEPA and activated-carbon filtration for engineering plastics.

Need a part that has to handle heat, load or wear? Start a project and I will suggest the right material.
body.sl:
V delavnici zdaj ob P1S tiska tudi Bambu Lab X2D. Kaj to pomeni za vaše dele:

- Dve šobi: ena tiska del, druga namenski podporni material, zato so previsi čistejši, z manj odpadka in manj dodelave.
- Aktivno ogrevana komora (do 65 °C) in šoba do 300 °C: ABS, ASA, najlon (PA), najlon z ogljikovimi vlakni (PA-CF) in PC se tiskajo zanesljivo, brez zvijanja.
- Delovni prostor 256 × 256 × 260 mm.
- AMS za večbarvne in večmaterialne izdelke.
- Vgrajeno filtriranje HEPA in z aktivnim ogljem za inženirske plastike.

Potrebujete del, ki mora zdržati toploto, obremenitev ali obrabo? Začnite projekt in predlagal bom pravi material.
